filingOfficeEn: Regional Alternative Child Care Office (RACCO / NACC) or initial intake via your City/Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (LSWDO). Confirm exact checklist at your regional RACCO.
filingOfficeFil: Regional Alternative Child Care Office (RACCO / NACC) o paunang pagtatasa sa City/Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (LSWDO). Kumpirmahin ang eksaktong listahan sa inyong RACCO.

items.nameEn: PSA Certificate of Live Birth of the Prospective Adoptive Parent(s)
items.nameFil: PSA Certificate of Live Birth ng Mag-aampon
items.reasonEn: Verifies your identity, age (at least 25 years old), and degree of relationship in Relative Adoption.
items.reasonFil: Nagpapatunay ng iyong pagkakakilanlan, edad (hindi bababa sa 25 taong gulang), at relasyon sa bata.

items.nameEn: PSA Certificate of Live Birth (or Certificate of Foundling) of the Child
items.nameFil: PSA Certificate of Live Birth (o Certificate of Foundling) ng Bata
items.reasonEn: Establishes the child's registered identity, age, and biological parentage on record.
items.reasonFil: Nagpapatunay ng nakarehistrong pangalan, edad, at magulang ng bata.

items.nameEn: PSA Marriage Certificate (if married) or CENOMAR (if single)
items.nameFil: PSA Marriage Certificate (kung kasal) o CENOMAR (kung walang asawa)
items.reasonEn: Required to verify civil status and joint spousal filing rules under RA 11642.
items.reasonFil: Kinakailangan upang patunayan ang civil status at kung magkasamang mag-aaplay ang mag-asawa.

items.nameEn: Recent Medical Certificate & Psychological Evaluation (as required by RACCO)
items.nameFil: Bagong Medical Certificate at Psychological Evaluation (kung hinihingi ng RACCO)
items.reasonEn: Shows physical and mental fitness to raise and care for a child.
items.reasonFil: Nagpapakita ng pisikal at mental na kakayahang mag-alaga ng bata.

items.nameEn: Valid NBI Clearance and Police Clearance
items.nameFil: Balidong NBI Clearance at Police Clearance
items.reasonEn: Protects the child by confirming the applicant has no disqualifying criminal record.
items.reasonFil: Pinoprotektahan ang bata sa pamamagitan ng pagtiyak na walang kasong kriminal ang mag-aampon.

items.nameEn: Proof of Financial Capacity (ITR, Certificate of Employment, Pension, or Barangay Indigency/Livelihood Proof)
items.nameFil: Patunay ng Kabuhayan (ITR, Certificate of Employment, Pensyon, o Katibayan ng Kita)
items.reasonEn: Demonstrates ability to provide basic support for the child; relative adopters are assessed compassionately by social workers.
items.reasonFil: Nagpapakita ng kakayahang sumuporta sa pangangailangan ng bata.

items.nameEn: Written Consent of Biological Parent(s) or CDCLAA, plus Child's Consent (if age 10+)
items.nameFil: Nakasulat na Pahintulot ng Tunay na Magulang o CDCLAA, at Pahintulot ng Bata (kung 10+ taong gulang)
items.reasonEn: Mandatory legal consent required before parental authority can be transferred.
items.reasonFil: Mahalagang legal na pahintulot bago mailipat ang parental authority.
items.whereToGet: Assisted by LSWDO / RACCO Social Worker

titleEn: Judicial Legal Guardianship of a Minor (A.M. No. 03-02-05-SC)
titleFil: Legal Guardianship ng Menor de Edad sa Korte
filingOfficeEn: Regional Trial Court (Family Court) where the minor resides. Indigent applicants should visit the Public Attorney's Office (PAO) first.
filingOfficeFil: Regional Trial Court (Family Court) kung saan nakatira ang bata. Magtungo muna sa PAO kung kwalipikado sa libreng abogado.

items.nameEn: PSA Birth Certificate of the Minor Child
items.nameFil: PSA Birth Certificate ng Menor de Edad
items.reasonEn: Proves the child is below 18 years old and shows parentage.
items.reasonFil: Nagpapatunay na wala pang 18 taong gulang ang bata.

items.nameEn: PSA Death Certificate of Parent(s) or Proof of Parental Absence/Incapacity
items.nameFil: PSA Death Certificate ng Magulang o Patunay ng Pagkawala/Kawalan ng Kakayahan
items.reasonEn: Establishes the legal ground why a court-appointed guardian is needed.
items.reasonFil: Nagpapatunay kung bakit kailangang magtalaga ng legal guardian ang korte.

items.nameEn: Proof of Relationship (Birth/Marriage Certificates linking Guardian to Child)
items.nameFil: Patunay ng Relasyon (Birth/Marriage Certificates ng Guardian at Magulang ng Bata)
items.reasonEn: Shows priority qualification of grandparents, siblings, or relatives.
items.reasonFil: Nagpapakita ng kaugnayan ng lolo, lola, o kamag-anak sa bata.

items.nameEn: Barangay Certificate of Residency and Actual Care
items.nameFil: Barangay Certificate of Residency at Actual Care
items.reasonEn: Confirms Family Court venue and that the minor resides with the petitioner.
items.reasonFil: Nagpapatunay ng tirahan ng bata at kasalukuyang nag-aalaga.

items.nameEn: Certificate of Indigency & Proof of Income (if applying for free PAO representation)
items.nameFil: Certificate of Indigency at Patunay ng Kita (kung hihingi ng libreng abogado sa PAO)
items.reasonEn: Used by PAO to assess qualification under the PAO Indigency Test.
items.reasonFil: Ginagamit ng PAO upang suriin kung kwalipikado sa libreng serbisyo legal.

titleFil: Pagtatama ng Maling Impormasyon sa Birth Certificate (RA 9048 / RA 10172)
filingOfficeEn: Local Civil Registry Office (LCRO) of the city/municipality where the birth was registered (or migrant petition at current residence LCRO).
filingOfficeFil: Local Civil Registry Office (LCRO) kung saan ipinarehistro ang bata.

items.nameEn: Latest PSA Copy of the Birth Certificate Showing the Error
items.nameFil: Pinakabagong Kopya ng PSA Birth Certificate na may Mali
items.reasonEn: Primary civil registry record to be annotated.
items.reasonFil: Pangunahing dokumento na lalagyan ng pagtatama.

items.nameEn: Certified True Copy of Local Civil Registry (Form 1A / Registry Book Page)
items.nameFil: Certified True Copy mula sa Local Civil Registry Office (LCRO)
items.reasonEn: Confirms how the entry was originally recorded at the municipal/city level.
items.reasonFil: Nagpapakita ng orihinal na rekord sa munisipyo o lungsod.

items.nameEn: At Least Two Public/Private Records Showing Correct Data (Baptismal, Earliest School Form 137, Medical/Immunization Record)
items.nameFil: Hindi Bababa sa Dalawang Dokumentong may Tamang Detalye (Baptismal, Form 137, Immunization Record)
items.reasonEn: Proves that the error was clerical and establishes the true entry.
items.reasonFil: Nagpapatunay kung ano ang tamang impormasyon mula pagkabata.

items.nameEn: NBI Clearance, Police Clearance, and Employer/No-Pending-Case Affidavit (for Change of First Name)
items.nameFil: NBI Clearance at Police Clearance (kung magpapalit ng Unang Pangalan)
items.reasonEn: Required under RA 9048 to ensure a first-name change is not used to evade legal obligations.
items.reasonFil: Hinihingi ng RA 9048 upang matiyak na walang tinatakasang pananagutan.
items.whereToGet: NBI / PNP / Notary Public or PAO

titleEn: Caregiver School, PhilHealth & Medical Authority Packet
titleFil: Mga Dokumento para sa Paaralan, PhilHealth, at Ospital ng Tagapag-alaga
filingOfficeEn: Present copies as needed to the child's School Registrar, PhilHealth Local Health Insurance Office, or LSWDO.
filingOfficeFil: Ipakita sa School Registrar, PhilHealth, o LSWDO kung kinakailangan.

items.nameEn: PSA Birth Certificate of the Child
items.nameFil: PSA Birth Certificate ng Bata
items.reasonEn: Required for school enrollment, PhilHealth dependent verification, and government programs.
items.reasonFil: Kinakailangan sa pag-aaral, PhilHealth, at mga programa ng gobyerno.

items.nameEn: Barangay Certification of Actual Care and Custody
items.nameFil: Barangay Certification ng Kasalukuyang Pag-aalaga sa Bata
items.reasonEn: Confirms the child is living in your household.
items.reasonFil: Nagpapatunay na ang bata ay nakatira at inaalagaan sa iyong tahanan.

items.nameEn: Notarized Special Power of Attorney (SPA) / Parental Authorization (if parents are alive and reachable)
items.nameFil: Notarized Special Power of Attorney (SPA) mula sa Magulang (kung buhay at nakakausap)
items.reasonEn: Empowers the grandparent or relative to sign school forms and consent to routine medical care.
items.reasonFil: Nagbibigay-pahintulot sa lolo, lola, o kamag-anak na pumirma sa paaralan at ospital.
items.whereToGet: Notary Public / PAO / Philippine Consulate (if OFW parent)

items.nameEn: LSWDO Intake / Social Worker Assessment (if parents are absent or abandoned the child)
items.nameFil: LSWDO Intake / Social Worker Assessment (kung wala o nang-iwan ang magulang)
items.reasonEn: Provides official social welfare documentation when parental signatures cannot be obtained.
items.reasonFil: Nagbibigay ng opisyal na dokumento mula sa social worker kung hindi mahagilap ang magulang.
items.whereToGet: Municipal / City Social Welfare and Development Office (LSWDO)

titleFil: Pagpaparehistro at Proteksyon ng Foundling / Inabandonang Bata (RA 11767)
filingOfficeEn: Municipal/City Social Welfare and Development Office (LSWDO), Regional RACCO/NACC, and Local Civil Registry Office (LCRO).
filingOfficeFil: Municipal/City Social Welfare and Development Office (LSWDO), Regional RACCO/NACC, at Local Civil Registry Office (LCRO).

items.nameEn: Barangay Blotter / BCPC Report and Police Report of Finding
items.nameFil: Barangay Blotter / BCPC Report at Police Report
items.reasonEn: Documents the date, place, and circumstances of how the child was found or left.
items.reasonFil: Nagtatala ng petsa, lugar, at pangyayari kung paano natagpuan o iniwan ang bata.
items.whereToGet: Barangay Hall / PNP Women and Children Protection Desk

items.nameEn: Sworn Affidavit of the Finder / Custodian
items.nameFil: Sinumpaang Salaysay (Affidavit) ng Nakakita o Nag-aalaga
items.reasonEn: Required by LSWDO and Local Civil Registrar for Certificate of Foundling processing.
items.reasonFil: Kinakailangan ng LSWDO at Local Civil Registrar para sa Certificate of Foundling.

items.nameEn: Social Case Study Report (SCSR) prepared by a Licensed Social Worker
items.nameFil: Social Case Study Report (SCSR) mula sa Lisensyadong Social Worker
items.reasonEn: Core assessment needed for child protection, foster care licensing, or NACC registration.
items.reasonFil: Pangunahing ulat para sa proteksyon ng bata, foster care, o rehistro sa NACC.
